provenance.construction: Dense-packed surface code ladder (arXiv:2511.06758 base, freed-m generalization per notes/367-19-5.md): two bands at vertical pitch d-1=8, horizontal patch pitch 2d+2=20; lower band m=6 rotated surface-code patches of distance d=9, upper band m-1=5, offset by half the horizontal pitch (brick-staggered). Data qubits at odd/odd sites; remaining occupied sites with (x+y)%4==2 measure X-checks, the rest Z-checks; every check acts on its four diagonal data neighbours (w=4, r=sqrt(2), single layer). Closed form n=((3d^2+1)m-(d^2+1))/2=691, k=2m-1=11. Builder anchored against research/build_dense_surface.py (m=3, d=9) and codes/367-19-5.json (m=10, d=5), both exact; single Tanner component (fused, not a direct sum).
